event: Can they catch Pip? The road runs past the tollhouse door, twelve miles downhill; Dray will run too.

From Ashlin Farm to Grey Shaw is some twelve miles of road, running gently downhill.

Dray would run with Nala himself, leaving Col Ashby and the Pells to hold the prisoners.

Wil reckons Pip won't think anyone is coming after him.

event: Nala and Dray run down the black lane onto the valley road, her Locks shut, her Water penned.

Locks choked, Nala cannot cycle; she runs on refined muscle alone, faster than any man, not a hound.

With her Locks choked, Nala's penned Water presses at them from within.

A half moon rises an hour after dark, enough to see the pale road by.

event: Ahead, light feet on the road, a stumble, a scramble of thorn: someone small goes to ground.

event: "Out you come, lad. The Reeve's law doesn't hang a boy of thirteen."

memory.fact: Dray calls Pip out of the hedge gruffly but not unkindly: a boy of thirteen does not hang.
Dray calls Pip out of the hedge gruffly but not unkindly: a boy of thirteen does not hang.

memory.fact: Pip carries a little clasp knife, and holds it out shaking when he is found, not to use it.

Told Crake is dead, Pip does not believe it until Dray shows him the stone of his fists.

memory.fact: Once Pip believes Crake is dead, he cries hard, as a child does, then all at once goes quiet.
Once Pip believes Crake is dead, he cries hard, as a child does, then all at once goes quiet.

event: They walk the last miles at the boy's pace; Nala's mouth is dry, undrunk since the afternoon.
Near ten, white birches and a tollhouse by an old toll bar, roofless at one end.

memory.fact: The ruined tollhouse sits at the wood's near edge, roofless at one end, by an old toll bar.
The ruined tollhouse sits at the wood's near edge, roofless at one end, by an old toll bar.

Crake's stash lies under the tollhouse hearthstone: bottled Water, a coin box, and his ledger.

event: The iron coin box is locked; the keys were on Crake's belt.

memory.fact: Crake's iron coin box is locked; its keys are on the ring at Crake's belt, back at Ashlin.
Crake's iron coin box is locked; its keys are on the ring at Crake's belt, back at Ashlin.

event: By law it goes to the watch, Dray says, but this came out of Talents; what would she do with it?

memory.fact: By law Crake's stash goes to the watch, but Dray asks Nala what she would have done with it.
By law Crake's stash goes to the watch, but Dray asks Nala what she would have done with it.

event: A Reeve holds it for Lady Varrow's court, but by custom the taker has a third.

memory.fact: Dray says a Reeve holds recovered goods for Lady Varrow's court; by custom the taker has a third.

The pit holds twenty-two small bottles of stolen Water, each a draught's worth, cold and dense.

event: Some is the captives' own Water; the bottles go first to them, the coin to those the ledger robbed.

memory.fact: Water from Crake's three captives is in the bottles; drunk back, it would speed their healing.
Water from Crake's three captives is in the bottles; drunk back, it would speed their healing.
Dray agrees the bottles go first to the freed captives, and the coin to those the ledger robbed.
Dray agrees the bottles go first to the freed captives, and the coin to those the ledger robbed.
Dray means Nala's third to be a third of the coin, on top of the five bars for Crake.
Dray means Nala's third to be a third of the coin, on top of the five bars for Crake.

event: The ledger names every Talent drained, every bottle sold, and the buyer, Oriel Vance; Pip flinches.

memory.fact: Crake's ledger names every Talent he drained, every bottle sold, and Oriel Vance as his buyer.
Crake's ledger names every Talent he drained, every bottle sold, and Oriel Vance as his buyer.
Dray says Lady Varrow will want Crake's ledger badly.
Dray says Lady Varrow will want Crake's ledger badly.
Pip flinched when Dray read the name Oriel Vance from Crake's ledger.
Pip flinched when Dray read the name Oriel Vance from Crake's ledger.

event: Sleep here till first light, or carry it back tonight? Back, Nala says, to watch the prisoners.

Dray offers to sleep at the tollhouse till first light, or carry the stash back to Ashlin tonight.

event: Dray takes bottles and ledger, Nala the coin box; Pip walks between them, up the moonlit road.

memory.fact: On the road back Dray carries the bottles and ledger, Nala the coin box, and Pip walks between.
On the road back Dray carries the bottles and ledger, Nala the coin box, and Pip walks between.

event: Past midnight a cold sweat breaks on her arms and neck and dries to fine grey salt.

memory.fact: On the night road back, Nala's penned Water seeps out of her skin as cold salt sweat.
On the night road back, Nala's penned Water seeps out of her skin as cold salt sweat.

Penned, Nala's Water presses at her choked Locks; by night it spills out as cold salt sweat.

event: Past two, Ashlin's lane: Col rises from the barn door. All quiet; Harl's sulking.

memory.fact: Carrying the stash uphill at Pip's pace, Nala and Dray reach Ashlin a little past two at night.
Carrying the stash uphill at Pip's pace, Nala and Dray reach Ashlin a little past two at night.

changes.note: Four silver bars, her third of Crake's coin

memory.fact: At Ashlin Dray counts Crake's coin and holds out four silver bars to Nala as her third.
At Ashlin Dray counts Crake's coin and holds out four silver bars to Nala as her third.
Nala's third of Crake's coin is four silver bars, of six hundred silver in all.
Nala's third of Crake's coin is four silver bars, of six hundred silver in all.

event: "You earned every one, and Crake's five besides. The watch pays those once they've seen him."

memory.fact: Thanked, Dray says Nala earned every bar, and Crake's five besides, and bids her drink and sleep.
Thanked, Dray says Nala earned every bar, and Crake's five besides, and bids her drink and sleep.

event: He locks the rest away, hangs the keys at his belt, and leaves her water and bread.

memory.fact: Dray keeps Crake's keys and the rest of the coin, and takes the next watch at the barn door himself.
Dray keeps Crake's keys and the rest of the coin, and takes the next watch at the barn door himself.

event: Her penned Water aches dully at throat and palms; wrapped in Anni's cloak, she sleeps, dreamless.

memory.fact: Penned behind her shut Locks, Nala's Water aches dully at her throat and palms.
Penned behind her shut Locks, Nala's Water aches dully at her throat and palms.

memory.fact: Near dawn Nala's Locks open one by one, soles first, then palms, and her throat last of all.
Near dawn Nala's Locks open one by one, soles first, then palms, and her throat last of all.

As each Lock opens, penned Water rushes through it like a held breath let go, and the ache eases.

Waking after the venom, Nala's Water moves stiff and slow, and Undertow answers weak.

On the march to the Ford, Dray shares the watch's bread, cheese and small beer with Nala.

Dray needs nothing more of Nala on the road, and bids her refine; the watch holds the prisoners.

Nala can refine bone as she walks, if left in silence; her mind, not her feet, holds the tide.

Refining her skull on the march, Nala's headache stays a dull pressure, easier than she feared.

By noon of day seventeen Nala's skull is well along; it, her hips and long bones remain.

memory.fact: Leaving Ashlin soon after dawn, the column reaches Wendle Ford a little after noon.
Leaving Ashlin soon after dawn, the column reaches Wendle Ford a little after noon.

Dray reads the account back aloud before Nala sets her mark to it.

On day seventeen's afternoon Nala's skull refines whole; the dull headache lasts till she sleeps.

On day nineteen the long bones of Nala's arms and her shins refine sweetly, barely aching.

event: They climb down; the pull fades behind her heels. At the Lantern: broth, bread, a road bundle.

changes.note: Supper and a road bundle at the Lantern

event: At dawn they take the road east up the valley, past scattered farms, she easily at his stirrup.

memory.fact: The road from the Ford to the Keep runs east up the valley, past scattered farms.
The road from the Ford to the Keep runs east up the valley, past scattered farms.

event: Past noon: Lady Varrow is cold of manner, but never forgets a debt.

memory.fact: Sir Edric warns Nala that Lady Varrow is cold of manner, but never forgets a debt.
Sir Edric warns Nala that Lady Varrow is cold of manner, but never forgets a debt.

event: By evening, an old grey tower-house on a crag at the valley's east end, roofs patched, walls dark.

memory.fact: Varrow Keep is an old grey tower-house on a crag at the valley's east end, a day from the Ford.
Varrow Keep is an old grey tower-house on a crag at the valley's east end, a day from the Ford.
The Keep's roofs are patched, its walls stained dark with old rain.
The Keep's roofs are patched, its walls stained dark with old rain.

event: They pass under the gate as the light goes; the bar thuds down behind them.

memory.fact: The Keep's gate is barred at dusk, and the Lady receives no one after dark.
The Keep's gate is barred at dusk, and the Lady receives no one after dark.

event: A steward gives her supper, a small cold room and a straw bed: the Lady receives in the morning.

memory.fact: A guest who reaches the Keep after noon is fed and lodged, and the Lady receives them next morning.
A guest who reaches the Keep after noon is fed and lodged, and the Lady receives them next morning.

event: Morning: up a winding stair to a long, draughty hall, a fire smoking at one end.

memory.fact: The Lady receives guests in a long, draughty hall up a winding stair, a fire smoking at one end.
The Lady receives guests in a long, draughty hall up a winding stair, a fire smoking at one end.

event: Sir Edric stands by a high-backed chair; in it a woman in grey watches. Nala bows and waits.

memory.fact: A guest who bows and waits to be spoken to pleases her; she notes it, and lets nothing show.

event: Lean, in grey worn thin, dark hair pinned tight, one white streak; pale eyes on her hands, her face.

memory.fact: She is lean, in a fine grey gown worn thin, dark hair pinned tight, one streak of white, pale eyes.
She is lean, in a fine grey gown worn thin, dark hair pinned tight, one streak of white, pale eyes.
She speaks briefly and never smiles, and watches a guest's hands and eyes as they talk.

event: The air is cold round the chair; frost skins its carved arms. "Nala. I am Imre Varrow."

memory.fact: The air near Lady Varrow is cold, and a skin of frost lies on the arms of her chair.
The air near Lady Varrow is cold, and a skin of frost lies on the arms of her chair.
She opens with the guest's name and her own, and no more courtesy than that.
She opens with the guest's name and her own, and no more courtesy than that.
Lady Imre Varrow, thirty-eight, rules House Varrow and Wendlemere from Varrow Keep.
Lady Imre Varrow, thirty-eight, rules House Varrow and Wendlemere from Varrow Keep.

event: Crake robbed her road a year and took three Talented off it; Nala kept it for her.

memory.fact: Crake robbed Lady Varrow's road for a year, and took three Talented off it.
Crake robbed Lady Varrow's road for a year, and took three Talented off it.

event: A servant brings a silver bar on grey cloth: "From the House. Take it." Nala thanks her.

changes.note: Lady Varrow gives a silver bar from the House for Crake

memory.fact: She thanks Nala for Crake, and gives her a silver bar from the House: the road was hers to keep.
She thanks Nala for Crake, and gives her a silver bar from the House: the road was hers to keep.

event: "Now. The crag. Tell me what you felt." She listens, eyes on Sir Edric now and then; he nods.

memory.fact: She bids Nala tell the crag again, and listens without a word, her eyes on Sir Edric now and then.
She bids Nala tell the crag again, and listens without a word, her eyes on Sir Edric now and then.

event: Dray wrote she came with no papers: where does she come from? She can't remember past a few weeks.

memory.fact: She asks where Nala comes from, since Dray wrote that she came to the Ford with no papers.
She asks where Nala comes from, since Dray wrote that she came to the Ford with no papers.

event: She's heard of folk the Sea touched losing their past; where did Nala first wake, and who saw her?

memory.fact: She has heard of folk the Sea touched losing their past, and does not call Nala's lost memory a lie.
She has heard of folk the Sea touched losing their past, and does not call Nala's lost memory a lie.
Told Nala remembers nothing past a few weeks, she asks where Nala first woke, and who saw her first.
Told Nala remembers nothing past a few weeks, she asks where Nala first woke, and who saw her first.

event: Garth Marsh was the first she met, if she has the name right; names slip from her.

memory.fact: Nala told Lady Varrow that Garth Marsh was the first she met, and that names slip from her.
Nala told Lady Varrow that Garth Marsh was the first she met, and that names slip from her.
She notes Nala gave a name, not a place, and lets it lie for now.

event: At Garth's name the frost on her chair arms creeps thicker, white and crisp.

memory.fact: At Garth Marsh's name, the frost on Lady Varrow's chair arms creeps thicker, white and crisp.
At Garth Marsh's name, the frost on Lady Varrow's chair arms creeps thicker, white and crisp.

event: She heard weeks ago of the stranger who drew his girl's rot; she had no Talent to spare him.

memory.fact: Lady Varrow heard weeks ago of a stranger who drew greymaw rot from Garth Marsh's girl.
Lady Varrow heard weeks ago of a stranger who drew greymaw rot from Garth Marsh's girl.
Garth's plea reached her, and she had no Talent to spare; Wren's life is a debt she owes Nala.
Garth's plea reached her, and she had no Talent to spare; Wren's life is a debt she owes Nala.

event: "A Talent that draws rot is worth more to this valley than any sword."

memory.fact: She values a Talent that draws rot above any sword, since the valley has no healer of that kind.
She values a Talent that draws rot above any sword, since the valley has no healer of that kind.

event: Sir Edric brings a disc of dark glass in a silver ring from a chest by the wall.

memory.fact: Her Spires glass is a disc of dark glass in a silver ring, kept in a chest by the hall wall.
Her Spires glass is a disc of dark glass in a silver ring, kept in a chest by the hall wall.

event: "This came from the Spires. It shows a Talent for what it is. Will you let me look at you?"

memory.fact: Lady Varrow says the glass came from the Spires and shows a Talent for what it is.
Lady Varrow says the glass came from the Spires and shows a Talent for what it is.
Lady Varrow asks Nala's leave before looking at her through the glass.
Lady Varrow asks Nala's leave before looking at her through the glass.

event: Pale light moves in the glass. She reads aloud: "Undertow. Major. Surface."

memory.fact: Through her glass, Nala reads as Undertow, Major, Surface, a greater Talent than any she holds.
Through her glass, Nala reads as Undertow, Major, Surface, a greater Talent than any she holds.
Through the Spires glass, a Talented one's Talent, Scope and Depth show as words of pale light.
A Talented eye that reads Talents reads hers as Undertow, Major, Surface.

event: Her well shows as a glow, sea-green and bright as a lamp, shining like a Second Depth's.

memory.fact: The glass also shows a Talented one's well as a glow; Nala's burns deep sea-green, bright as a lamp.
The glass also shows a Talented one's well as a glow; Nala's burns deep sea-green, bright as a lamp.
Asked, Lady Varrow reads Nala's words aloud, and says her well shines like a Second Depth's.
Asked, Lady Varrow reads Nala's words aloud, and says her well shines like a Second Depth's.

event: None of her four sworn Talented is Major, nor shines half so bright.

memory.fact: None of the four Talented sworn to Lady Varrow is Major, nor shines half so bright in her glass.
None of the four Talented sworn to Lady Varrow is Major, nor shines half so bright in her glass.

event: Swear to House Varrow: a bar a month, a room at the Keep, a knight's rank; stand with them.

memory.fact: She offers Nala a place sworn to House Varrow: a bar a month, a room at the Keep, a knight's rank.
She offers Nala a place sworn to House Varrow: a bar a month, a room at the Keep, a knight's rank.
Sworn to her, Nala would help hold the valley against whatever is under the Whitecombs.
Sworn to her, Nala would help hold the valley against whatever is under the Whitecombs.

event: Nala won't swear, but will help, and stay to face it, if the Lady helps her grow strong.

memory.fact: Nala refused to swear to House Varrow, but will help and stay if Lady Varrow helps her grow strong.
Nala refused to swear to House Varrow, but will help and stay if Lady Varrow helps her grow strong.

event: Skin, muscle and bone in three weeks; most Talented take years. Her pale eyes narrow.

memory.fact: Skin, muscle and bone refined in three weeks astonishes her; most Talented take years.
Skin, muscle and bone refined in three weeks astonishes her; most Talented take years.

event: Then a lesser bond: a free blade called on at need, a bar a summons, and her house's guidance.

memory.fact: If Nala will not swear, she offers a lesser bond: paid as a free blade, called on at need.
If Nala will not swear, she offers a lesser bond: paid as a free blade, called on at need.
As a free blade, Nala is paid a silver bar for each summons from the Keep she answers.
As a free blade, Nala is paid a silver bar for each summons from the Keep she answers.
For the lesser bond, Lady Varrow offers Nala guidance, her own and her house's.
For the lesser bond, Lady Varrow offers Nala guidance, her own and her house's.
Refused an oath, Lady Varrow lets nothing show; she takes the lesser bond, and remembers.

event: She has Descended twice: refine your organs before going down, and spar with her Talented here.

memory.fact: Lady Varrow has Descended twice, and offers Nala her own counsel on Descent and Tribulation.
Lady Varrow has Descended twice, and offers Nala her own counsel on Descent and Tribulation.
She advises Nala to refine her organs before Descending, as few have the time or Water to.
She advises Nala to refine her organs before Descending, as few have the time or Water to.
She would have Nala spar with her Talented at the Keep, to learn to fight other Talents.
She would have Nala spar with her Talented at the Keep, to learn to fight other Talents.

event: "Acceptable." "Sir Edric. Witness it." She holds out a lean hand, frost glittering on the knuckles.

memory.fact: Lady Varrow seals a free blade's bond with a clasp of hands before a witness, written in the rolls.
Lady Varrow seals a free blade's bond with a clasp of hands before a witness, written in the rolls.

event: Nala clasps it; the cold bites, then fades. "Witnessed. Nala, free blade of Varrow Keep."

memory.fact: Frost glitters on Lady Varrow's knuckles; her hand's cold bites at a clasp, then fades.
Frost glitters on Lady Varrow's knuckles; her hand's cold bites at a clasp, then fades.
Nala took Lady Varrow's lesser bond; Sir Edric witnessed it, naming her free blade of Varrow Keep.
Nala took Lady Varrow's lesser bond; Sir Edric witnessed it, naming her free blade of Varrow Keep.

event: A room at the top of the old north stair, hers alone; she eats at the second table in the hall.

memory.fact: The Keep gives Nala a room at the top of its old north stair: bare, quiet, with a shuttered window.
The Keep gives Nala a room at the top of its old north stair: bare, quiet, with a shuttered window.
A free blade at the Keep eats in the hall with the Talented, at the second table.
A free blade at the Keep eats in the hall with the Talented, at the second table.

event: The well is in the lower court, deep and cold, from the crag's own spring.

memory.fact: The Keep's well is in its lower court, deep and cold, fed from the crag's spring.
The Keep's well is in its lower court, deep and cold, fed from the crag's spring.

event: Every Tribulation differs; hers came as cold that tried to stop her heart. Make yours strong first.

memory.fact: She tells Nala every Tribulation differs, but hers came as cold that tried to stop her heart.
She tells Nala every Tribulation differs, but hers came as cold that tried to stop her heart.

event: Her Talented train in the lower court at first light: will Nala start tomorrow, or refine first?

memory.fact: Lady Varrow's Talented train in the Keep's lower court at first light.
Lady Varrow's Talented train in the Keep's lower court at first light.
